title: Ely Court, Ely Square, Nutgrove Avenue, Rathfarnham, Dublin 14
seoTitle: Ely Court, Ely Square, Nutgrove Avenue, Rathfarnham, Dublin 14
description:
Herbert & Lansdowne are delighted to present this brand-new two-bedroom apartment at Ely Court, Ely Square, Nutgrove Avenue, Rathfarnham, Dublin 14 to the rental market.

Ely Court is a newly completed development of 19 apartments within the established Ely Square development, offering brand-new, A-rated accommodation finished to a high standard throughout. A selection of two-bedroom apartments is available within the development.

The apartment offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation with a modern and considered finish throughout. The accommodation comprises an entrance hall leading to a spacious open-plan living, dining and kitchen area. The contemporary fitted kitchen provides generous storage together with a full range of integrated appliances, while the living and dining space opens directly onto a private balcony.

There are two generously proportioned double bedrooms, both benefiting from excellent fitted wardrobe space. The main bedroom also benefits from an ensuite shower room, while the main bathroom is finished with large-format tiling and a bath with overhead shower. Additional workspace is incorporated within the bedroom accommodation, together with excellent storage throughout.

The property has been designed with energy efficiency and modern living in mind and benefits from an A-rated BER, high-quality fixtures and fittings and excellent natural light throughout.

Ely Court is serviced by a lift and each apartment has the benefit of one designated parking space. Additional on-street parking is available in the surrounding area, subject to availability. Residents also have access to secure bicycle storage, electric bicycle and scooter charging facilities and landscaped communal green areas within the development.

Ely Square enjoys an excellent position on Nutgrove Avenue in Rathfarnham, with a wide range of shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities within easy reach. Nutgrove Shopping Centre is only a short distance away, while Rathfarnham Village and Dundrum Town Centre are also conveniently accessible.

The area is particularly well served for recreational and outdoor amenities, with Marlay Park and Rathfarnham Castle nearby, together with a wide selection of sports clubs, gyms and golf courses. The Dublin Mountains are also within easy reach, providing an extensive choice of walking and recreational routes.

Transport connections are excellent, with regular bus services operating close to the development and convenient access to Dublin city centre, Dundrum, Sandyford and the M50 motorway network.

A limited selection of two-bedroom apartments is available within Ely Court from €2,550 to €2,850 per month, with floor level, layout and outlook varying between apartments.

Photographs are of a representative show apartment within Ely Court and include styling and decorative accessories for presentation purposes. Individual apartment layouts, furnishings and outlooks may vary. Apartments will be let furnished; bed linen and decorative accessories shown are not included.
